text.en:
(r) To be classified as indigent patient so as to be
absolutely free from any and all charges incurred by the hospital
during his confinement and have priority in accommodation, one
Shall have a total income of not more than one hundred twenty
pesos a month, if not married; if he is married or head of family,
each additional member shall be given thirty pesos as allowance
to the total income of the family but not to exceed two hundred
ten pesos a month; if he is a member of a family, the total income

of the family should not be more than two hundred ten pesos a
month. Said category of patients shall be absolutely free from any
and all charges incurred by the hospital during their confinement
and such patients shall further have priority in accommodation.
(b) To be classified as partial pay patient so as to be entitled
to free professional services in a government hospital, one shall
have a total income of more than one hndred twenty pesos but not
more than two hundred ten pesos a month, if not married; if
he is married or head of a family, each additional member shall
be given thirty pesos as allowance to the total income o1 the family
but not to exceed three hundred pesos a morth; if he is a member
of a family, the total income of the family shall not be more than
three hundred pesos a month. Said category of patients shall pay
only the cost of medicines used and the hospitalization fees.
(c) To be ciassified as full pay patient, one shall have an
income of more than three hundred pesos a month, irrespective of
whether or not he or she is single or married and or head of a
family. If he is a member of a family, the total income of the
family must be more than three hundred pesos a month. Said
category of patients shall pay not only the medicines used and hospi-
talization charges but also the professional fees.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 24th day of March, in
the jear of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-three,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the seventh.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippints.
By the President:
MARcIANO ROQUE
Acting Executrve Secretary
